author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: उक्तरूपेण तं ज्ञात्वा युद्धादिस्वकर्मणा तमाराध्याशेषदुःखं परिहरेति भावः
translation: He is unmanifest; He is incomprehensible; He is not changeable ; He is (so) described (by the Srutis). Therefore, it is not fit that having known this (soul) to be such, thou shouldst grieve. (25.)
